mappings.sig_proposition: Will the Democratic Party win the Colorado Senate?
mappings.polymarket_question: Will the Democrats win the Colorado Senate race in 2026?
mappings.approval_note: Exact research mapping reviewed from scoped SIG Party Winner resolution root and Polymarket party-nominee rules; independent YES/NO contract, not inferred from the opposing party.
settlement_notes: Both ordinary outcomes mean the Democratic Party nominee wins this exact 2026 general Senate election. Polymarket explicitly follows replacement nominees and excludes independents from party options.
Cross-venue equivalence is conditional on ordinary settlement only, not an executable arbitrage or LIVE authorization.

Polymarket includes run-offs and resolves on AP/Fox/NBC agreement or official certification. SIG exposes Party Winner plus election/stage IDs but does not promise the same source hierarchy or runoff/nominee-replacement handling.

Scheduled end/settlement timestamps differ and are not guarantees of final resolution. Cancellation/N/A/refund and administrator/oracle dispute/override behavior may differ; unresolved exceptional outcomes require re-review.

mappings.sig_proposition: Will the Democratic Party win the Alaska Senate?
mappings.approval_note: No exact party-winner contract found in the official Alaska event/public search or the exact Democratic/Republican party slugs. No candidate token substituted.
settlement_notes: SIG resolves Party Winner; Polymarket resolves named candidates, not a party nominee contract. Candidate replacement, multiple same-party candidates and Alaska ranked-choice results prevent assuming equivalence.
Polymarket adds a July 31, 2027 deadline resolving to Other if unconfirmed, with no equivalent rule in the SIG root. NO_EQUIVALENT_EXTERNAL_MARKET; no external edge or signal calculated.
